title: Traveling minstrel and tent shows
summary: He did not like show work but names shows his friends were on and a band formed from one.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Did you ever hear many minstrel shows or other traveling tent shows that would come around? Or did you ever work with any of those? There were a lot of...

Well, I never did care too much for working on the shows, but I had a lot of friends that did work on them. I remember Georgia Smart Set, Silas Green, and also the Georgia Minister, Rabbit Foot. That was the one Jalee Davis was on, Sweet Papa Snowball they call it, he was on Rabbit Foot. That's through the running, I think. Yeah, they had Carter and Poe Gibson. And then, uh, Holkamp, he had, uh, Georgia Smart Set. Yeah. I had a lot of boys. I, uh, I, uh, organized a band with some of the boys out of that, when the show went, you know, bomb, I ordered, I made up a band with, uh, some of the boys out of the show. Doc Pomley, Luke Pomley, those two brothers, they were on the, Georgia Smart Set.
Did those shows, uh, just travel mostly in the summertime and what they do in the winters?
Well, they, they put up in the runters, you know, head caught in some place.
How long would they stay in that place? One night stands or a week or usually or what?
Well, most, uh, it was one night stands, one nighters.
